title: Intelligent Embedding Pruning for Large-Scale Recommendation Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.25288v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern recommendation systems face substantial memory pressure, largely from the sparse embedding layer that maps high-cardinality categorical features into dense vectors. In-training embedding pruning (ITEP) removes less important embedding rows during training, yielding end-to-end memory savings but sometimes degrading accuracy because per-table pruning ratios are set by size-based heuristics. We use feature importance (FI) to guide these ratios (FI-ITEP), assigning higher pruning to tables tied to less important features. Across three large-scale recommendation models, FI-ITEP achieves 20--40% total memory reduction while matching or improving accuracy relative to percentile-based ITEP. Because the feature-importance signal requires minimal resources to compute, these memory savings translate into concrete systems benefits: the same models train on fewer GPU trainers (e.g., 112 to 80) with higher per-GPU throughput, saving 1,000+ GP

translated_title: 面向大规模推荐模型的智能嵌入剪枝
translated_abstract: 现代推荐系统面临巨大的内存压力，这主要源于将高基数类别特征映射为稠密向量的稀疏嵌入层。训练中嵌入剪枝（ITEP）在训练过程中移除不那么重要的嵌入行，从而带来端到端的内存节省，但由于各表的剪枝比例是由基于规模的启发式方法设定的，有时会降低模型准确率。我们利用特征重要性（FI）来指导这些剪枝比例（FI-ITEP），对与较不重要特征相关联的表分配更高的剪枝比例。在三个大规模推荐模型上，FI-ITEP 相比基于百分位数的 ITEP 实现了 20%–40% 的总内存减少，同时保持或提升了准确率。由于特征重要性信号的计算所需资源极少，这些内存节省转化为具体的系统收益：相同的模型可以在更少的 GPU 训练节点上完成训练（例如从 112 个减少到 80 个），且每个 GPU 的吞吐量更高，节省了 1000+ GPU 资源。
tldr: 该论文提出利用特征重要性来指导训练中嵌入剪枝的各表剪枝比例（FI-ITEP），在三个大规模推荐模型上实现 20%–40% 的内存节省并保持或提升准确率，同时显著减少训练所需的 GPU 数量。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes FI-ITEP, which uses feature importance to guide per-table pruning ratios in in-training embedding pruning, achieving 20-40% total memory reduction while matching or improving accuracy across three large-scale recommendation models, and enabling training on fewer GPUs with higher per-GPU throughput.
